component.name: TypEmoji
component.summary: Direct emoji picker and typing utility for Linux

description.p: TypEmoji is a fast, lightweight emoji selector and direct typing tool for Linux. It allows you to search and insert Unicode emojis directly into any focused window across both X11 and Wayland (KDE Plasma, GNOME, Sway, and other compositors).

ul.li: Instant search by keyword, name, and category
Recent emojis memory for quick access
Direct keyboard typing injection into target applications
System tray integration for quick access and background daemon support
Support for both X11 and Wayland environments

description.p: Resolved duplicate tray icon issue on login by cleaning up redundant systemd user autostart services and standardizing on XDG Autostart specification, with atomic QLockFile single-instance mutual exclusion to prevent race conditions during desktop login.

Fixed multi-emoji continuous typing on Linux Wayland/X11 desktops, prevented premature focus loss dismissal during asynchronous injection, and added a header Pin button toggle for rapid multi-emoji typing.
Windows-Style Common Grouper (grid deduplication), interactive colour and skin tone selector bar, instant variation flyout on corner triangle click or right-click, and live viewport repainting.

Configurable global hotkeys with live key sequence recorder, usage history JSON export/import, expanded 89-item curated Japanese kaomoji catalog, and customizable grid density (Compact, Standard, Large).
Visual redesign and UX overhaul: spacious geometry, concentric rounded design, vector search bar, pill category tabs, jitter-free emoji cells, and elevated preview bar.
Major update: Cross-distro support with XDG Desktop Portal for GNOME and Sway, batched emoji queue typing, Escape/Ctrl+Q instant window dismiss, and optional KDE dependencies.
Initial release with full Unicode 16.0 support, Wayland and X11 hotkey injection, search, and categorization.
